mapper.select: select coalesce((select view_count from article_views where article_id = #{articleId}), 0)
select count(1) from article_favorites where article_id = #{articleId}
select count(1) from comments where article_id = #{articleId}

select A.slug, A.title, A.description, U.username as author, count(AF.user_id) as favoriteCount from articles A inner join article_favorites AF on A.id = AF.article_id left join users U on U.id = A.user_id where A.created_at >= datetime('now', '-7 days') group by A.id order by favoriteCount desc limit #{limit}
